provenance.author: UyghurCommunity
provenance.origin: Original task prompts and draft references created for this project with AI assistance. No external dictionary or evaluation dataset was copied.
provenance.review_status: Not reviewed by Uyghur language experts. Contributions should include independent review of prompts, keys, and rubrics.
provenance.scope: Small, public software and language evaluation starter set; not a representative benchmark or a leaderboard.

scoring.automatic: One point per exact or multiple-choice task. Missing automatic responses count as incorrect.
scoring.normalization: Unicode NFC, normalized line endings, outer whitespace trimming; case-insensitive only when explicitly enabled per task. No Uyghur letters, hamza, marks, or joiners are removed.
scoring.human: Human-review tasks are never included in the automatic accuracy denominator. Rubrics and references are drafts, not definitive translations.

«ئالما|ئۆرۈك|ئانار» تېكىستىدىكى | بەلگىلىرىنى / بەلگىسىگە ئالماشتۇرۇڭ. بوشلۇق قوشماڭ.
«2,1,3» نومۇرلىرىنى كىچىكتىن چوڭغا تىزىڭ. ئوخشاش پەش شەكلىنى ساقلاڭ، بوشلۇق قوشماڭ.
